AGENTS.md

This file provides guidance to coding agents when working with code in this repository.

Overview

shiny is the R package for building reactive web applications. The server side is R (R/); the browser client is TypeScript (srcts/) bundled into inst/www/shared/. Many UI components and themes come from the bslib and htmltools packages.

Development Commands

# R
Rscript -e 'devtools::load_all()'                  # Load for interactive work
Rscript -e 'devtools::document()'                  # Regenerate man/, NAMESPACE, Collate
Rscript -e 'devtools::test()'                      # All testthat tests
Rscript -e 'devtools::test(filter = "reactivity")' # One file: tests/testthat/test-reactivity.r
Rscript -e 'devtools::check()'                     # Full R CMD check

# TypeScript (run `npm ci` once first)
npm run build      # Lint, type check, TS tests, and bundle into inst/www/shared/
npm run watch      # Rebuild shiny.js on change
npm run checks     # Lint, tsc, TS tests, type coverage, circular imports

Memory Bank

The memory-bank/ directory holds contributor documentation with YAML frontmatter (title, description). Before exploring the codebase, invoke the memory-bank skill to find and read the relevant docs. Update or add docs when you learn something future contributors will need (see the skill for conventions).

Contributor skills live in .agents/skills/; .claude/skills is a symlink to it. Only allowlisted skills are tracked, so when adding or removing one, update the !/.agents/skills/<name>/ lines in .gitignore to match.

Start with:

  • memory-bank/architecture.md - reactivity, sessions, modules, bindings, async, and where each lives
  • memory-bank/assets.md - the TypeScript build and vendored JS/CSS libraries
  • memory-bank/testing.md - running and writing shiny’s own tests, and CI
  • memory-bank/documentationStyle.md - roxygen, pkgdown reference index, NEWS.md
  • memory-bank/commitConventions.md - commit messages, PR titles, merging
  • memory-bank/agentSkills.md - the bundled inst/skills/shiny-for-r/ skill

Bundled Agent Skill

The package ships an Agent Skill for app authors under inst/skills/shiny-for-r/. Treat it like user-facing documentation: when a change touches a public API it documents, update the skill in the same PR. Read memory-bank/agentSkills.md before editing it.

Sibling Repo: py-shiny

posit-dev/py-shiny is Shiny for Python. Keep the two from drifting apart:

  • Client JS and wire protocol: py-shiny vendors this package’s inst/www/shared/ (including shiny.js) via make upgrade-html-deps, so srcts/ changes reach it on its next upgrade. If the change also needs Python server support (a new message type, input/output contract, etc.), open an issue in py-shiny describing it.
  • Server behavior and bugs: when a fix or feature here likely applies to py-shiny too, don’t make the change in both repos at once; open an issue in py-shiny and cross-link it. gh issue create -R posit-dev/py-shiny --label ai-generated-issue
  • Agent infrastructure (AGENTS.md conventions, .agents/skills/memory-bank/, and the PR title and squash-merge parts of memory-bank/commitConventions.md): mirror shared changes with a PR in py-shiny. The rest of commitConventions.md (routine, rc-v*, build commits) is specific to this repo.

Common Pitfalls

  • New R files: DESCRIPTION has an explicit Collate: field. Run devtools::document() after adding a file so it gets collated.
  • Generated files: Don’t hand-edit man/, NAMESPACE, or inst/www/shared/shiny*.js; edit the roxygen comments or srcts/ and regenerate.
  • NEWS.md: User-facing changes need a bullet under # shiny (development version).
